title: Project Foundation
objective: Create the minimal project foundation required before Android device automation: Python package skeleton, configuration loader, structured JSONL logging, startup health check, project-state file, and deterministic unit tests. Do not implement ADB actions, UIAutomator selectors, WebView, OCR, Vision, workflows, or desktop UI yet.
scope: startup health-check command for Python and optional external tools
architecture_constraints: No blind clicks or fixed-coordinate logic
All I/O must be timeout/cancellation-ready when introduced
No secrets in sample config or logs
acceptance_criteria: python -m control_android.health exits 0 on a normal developer machine even when optional Android tools are absent, while reporting missing optional dependencies as WARN
JSONL logger emits parseable JSON with timestamp, level, event, and optional context
sample config loads successfully and invalid numeric values fail validation
.ai/project_state.json exists and records G00 as TESTING or DONE only according to test evidence
review_request: Challenge the scope, architecture boundaries, testability, and whether any Goal 0 item should be deferred. Do not code. Return blocking issues first.
